name: Single-Leg Calf Raises
description: A harder calf raise: with one foot lifted and a hand on the wall, rise slowly onto the ball of the standing foot.

source.title: NHS podiatry: calf strengthening guide
source.note: Stick-figure approximation; the heel is drawn at the ankle.

setup: Stand on a level surface, holding a wall or stable surface.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and lift your right foot.
cues: Take about 3 seconds to rise and 3 seconds to lower.
Keep the standing knee straight but not locked.
Stay tall; don't lean on the wall.

prescription.note: Start with 5 repetitions on each leg 3 times a day and build up to 20 repetitions 5 times a day.

keyframes.name: Stand on your left leg
keyframes.cue: Weight on the left foot, right foot lifted behind you.

keyframes.name: Rise onto your toes
keyframes.cue: Slowly lift your left heel until you're on the ball of the foot.
